task.title: Audit the checkout page for the machine-detectable failures
task.description: The checkout page ships with a low-contrast Pay button, an image with no alt text and an input with no label.
criteria: The checkout page has no WCAG 2.2 AA failure axe can find

testCases.title: Pay form renders
testCases.approach: the checkout page is open at /, the page loads, the pay form, its image and the Pay button are visible
testCases.given: the checkout page is open at /
testCases.then: the pay form, its image and the Pay button are visible
